Exceptional Scepters
(Normal Scepters | Elite Scepters)

These blunt weapons are especially effective against the undead-those who resist the eternal slumber. For this reason, the holy knights of Zakarum are commonly seen brandishing such weapons against these living dead. The Church of Zakarum is rumored to have created scepters of incredible power to be wielded by those that devoutly follow the ways of Light and Virtue.

All Scepters give a bonus of +50% Damage to Undead. Scepters can have up to 3 staffmods (bonuses to specific Paladin skills), each ranging from +1 to +3 to skill level.
